dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's almost time for the expo to end... I'm asking for half a month's leave once we wrap this up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally got time to relax, huh, Jahoda?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yeah, thanks to you. Things are pretty calm right now. Should be smooth sailing from here on out...

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I've got a problem over here.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Same here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (...Jahodaaaaa... You just jinxed it!)

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Someone made off with a batch of my goods using the "goods first, pay later" method. I thought the Guild was the guarantor, but then I went to redeem my money, and... no dice.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The same thing happened to me.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "Goods first, pay later?" That convenience is for exhibitors only. It works because their goods stored in the warehouse can be used as collateral.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: The buyer did have Guild-supplied certification.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: In that case, he's one of you. Pick him out of the crowd, and we're good to go.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: ...The person I talked to was a tall, thin young man, but I don't see him here.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The one who bought from me was on the chubbier side — and nope, no sign of him either.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wait, so... it wasn't the same person?

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Miss Jahoda, we need help! Ati went into town a while back, and we haven't heard from him!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What? Why would he do that?

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: He wanted to use the Mora we got from our exhibit to buy everyone a little something in return for looking out for us, so he headed out alone...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Gods, this kid... Wait, did he have your certification from the Guild with him?

dialogues.speaker: Neb
dialogues.text: Yeah, he's our older brother, so he's in charge of all that stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh, this is bad...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's not panic. What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Remember those people who targeted Ati a while back? I'm worried they kidnapped him and are using his certification to scam goods off the other exhibitors...

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: Sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This isn't your fault.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Should we rescue Ati first? But Nod-Krai's huge. Where would we even start? We could go for the goods first, but we're dealing with a group. If they split up, it'll be impossible to nab 'em...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (C'mon, Jahoda, c'mon... You promised Boss Nef you'd uphold the Guild's reputation, and you promised the kids you'd protect them... This is all falling apart!)

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Looks like you're down to your last option, dumpster-diver.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh... right! The Clink-Clank Crisis Control Switch!

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Clink-Clank Crisis Control Switch activated.

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Awaiting orders... Awaiting orders... Awaiting orders...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Activating the switch gives you temporary control over all the robots in Nod-Krai — if you wanted, you could turn this whole place upside down!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But it won't last long, so think about what you wanna do first.

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: In that case, let's get the stolen goods back first!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...All units advance to rescue Ati!

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: Miss Jahoda...

dialogues.speaker: Robot
dialogues.text: Orders received... Orders received... Orders received...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With the help of the robots, Ati is quickly rescued, and the people holding him scatter and flee.

dialogues.speaker: Raya
dialogues.text: Ati! You're alright!

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: Sorry... I made you all worry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If anyone should be apologizing, it's those awful people who took you. You just wanted to repay everyone's kindness.

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: They stole my expo certificate. Did that... cause trouble for anyone?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let's just focus on one thing at a time...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Inventory complete. All goods have been retrieved.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: See? Told ya. With the Clink-Clank Crisis Control Switch, there's no problem in Nod-Krai you can't handle!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: With so many bots around, we didn't have to choose between the rescue and getting the goods back. We were able to do both!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Aino...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: These kids call me Boss, and as their Boss, it's my job to protect 'em. No way I'm letting them get in trouble with the Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Ati
dialogues.text: Thanks, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino's a great person to have on your side, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: To be honest, I could hug you right now... But I think I'll have that vacation first.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh, right! I owe you a Hot Dog, don't I?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Jahoda finally catches a break, and is free from further drama for the time being.
